mapper.select: SELECT t1.CORP_GR , t1.TR_YMD , t1.FUND_CD , t1.TR_CO_CD , t1.HWANIB_AEK , t1.TR_CD , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_cd , t1.BAL_AEK , F_TR_CO_NM(t1.CORP_GR, t1.TR_CO_CD) AS xx_tr_co_cd , t1.BF_YMD , t1.AF_YMD , t1.BIGO , 1 AS P_VISIBLE FROM SKT0HS t1 , SZM0IA ia WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.TR_YMD = #{trYmd} AND t1.TR_CD = #{trCd} AND ia.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD ORDER BY t1.FUND_CD ASC
SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(t1.TR_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tr_ymd FROM SKT0HS t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.TR_CD IN (SELECT tr_cd FROM SZX1PT WHERE obj_id = 'W_JA031M') ORDER BY tr_ymd ASC

SELECT ia.FUND_NM AS fund_nm , ia.MG_CD AS mg_cd , (SELECT CD_NM FROM SZX2MM WHERE CORP_GR = ia.CORP_GR AND CL_CD = '3000' AND CD = ia.MG_CD) AS xx_mg_cd FROM SZM0IA ia WHERE ia.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND ia.FUND_CD = #{fundCd}
